name: Being Fired Now Im Out Of Their League
original_name: Being Fired Now Im Out Of Their League
overview: The plot focuses on Julián, who is forced to get engaged to Serena by orders of his grandfather. He works undercover for six months at Empresas Herrera to propel her into the queen of Wall Street. However, Serena and her assistant, Damián, ungratefully fire him, not knowing that the success and stability of the company will collapse without Julián's protection and genius.
